name: Martin J. Whitman School of Management

work_exp_years.stat: average, published as 44 months of average work experience

tuition_usd.note: US News lists 2015 USD per credit (54-credit program); no per-year figure seen

salary_median_usd.stat: average median base salary for MBA graduates, Classes of 2024-25 (page also lists 125,692 average mean base salary)

employment_rate_pct.stat: MBA employment rate within three months; employment data reflects a five-year average under CSEA standards

notes: The official class profile page states 650 Average GMAT with a 574-698 range (20-80th percentile) but does not label the exam edition and gives no class year, so per protocol neither gmat_focus nor gmat_classic is set; the prior third-party 645 figure should be dropped. The profile page is undated (year 2026 reflects fetch date and site copyright). Tuition is published only as a standard graduate rate of 2,086 USD per credit hour for 2026-27 (54-credit program) with no annual tuition figure, on https://whitman.syracuse.edu/graduate-programs/full-time-mba-program/full-time-mba-estimates-program-costs. No class size, GRE, women, international, or acceptance-rate figures on reachable official pages.
